description: Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse said the cryptocurrency sector’s long-term growth does not depend solely on the CLARITY Act becoming law. Speaking at The Economic Club of Kansas City on September 15, he argued that faster and more capable technology could drive adoption despite regulatory setbacks. His comments followed the Senate’s failure to advance the market structure bill in a 49-50 procedural vote.
title: Ripple CEO Says Crypto Sector Can Grow Beyond CLARITY Act

description: ViewSonic has introduced its Google TV Series in India alongside several professional display products at InfoComm India 2026. The Google TV models run Google TV Ref+ 5.0 based on Android 14 and are available in five screen sizes from 32 inches to 65 inches. The company has also introduced new Direct View LED displays, a 105-inch interactive display, professional monitors, a commercial display and a short-throw laser projector. Pricing and wider availability details for these products have not been announced.
title: ViewSonic Google TV Series Launched in India With Up to 65-Inch Models Alongside New Pro AV Displays

description: Sony has announced the PlayStation Pulse and Pulse Edge Wireless Headsets as its latest audio accessories for PS5. Both models feature custom planar magnetic drivers, PlayStation Link connectivity and AI-enhanced microphone noise rejection. The Pulse Edge adds active noise cancellation, a detachable boom microphone, a carrying case and PS5 game audio and chat balance controls. The PlayStation Pulse is scheduled to arrive in select markets during the 2026 holiday season, while the Pulse Edge will launch in early 2027.
title: PlayStation Pulse, Pulse Edge Wireless Headsets Announced With Planar Magnetic Drivers for PS5

description: iQOO Pad Ultra will launch in China on September 29 at 7pm local time (4:30pm IST). It will launch in Ender Black and Star Armour Silver (translated from Chinese) colour options. The new tablet will be alongside the iQOO 16.  iQOO Pad Ultra is rumoured to ship with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. iQOO Pad Ultra is teased to feature an 8.8-inch display.
title: iQOO Pad Ultra Set to Launch on September 29; Design, Key Specifications Revealed

description: BitMart has launched an exclusive feedback channel for users to submit questions and proposals as Alvarez & Marsal assesses the exchange’s financial situation and future options. The portal covers withdrawals, general feedback, potential investment or restructuring proposals, and other queries. The exchange is also preparing an action plan and consultation process following its decision to wind down trading operations.
title: BitMart Opens User Engagement Portal During Withdrawal Plan Review

description: OriginOS 7 is scheduled to launch globally on September 21, with Vivo and iQOO opening preview programmes for users in India. The Vivo X300 Pro and iQOO 15 are eligible for the early-access programmes, which are limited to 500 users each. iQOO will accept registrations until September 20, while Vivo has not announced an official closing date. The preview software is based on Android 17, and selected users can access it before the stable update reaches the two smartphones.
title: Vivo X300 Pro, iQOO 15 Get Android 17-Based OriginOS 7 Preview Programme in India Ahead of Global Launch

description: Samsung Galaxy A08 has been launched in select global markets as the company’s latest phone with 4G connectivity. The new smartphone is currently available for purchase via the Samsung Ukraine online store. The Samsung Galaxy A08 is offered in three colour options, namely Dark Blue, Green, and Silver (translated from Ukrainian). It is powered by an octa-core MediaTek Helio G99 chipset, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.2GHz, along with a 6,000mAh battery. The phone features a 50-megapixel primary rear camera.
title: Samsung Galaxy A08 Launched With 6,000mAh Battery and 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Asus Vivobook S16, Vivobook S14, Vivobook 14 Flip, Vivobook S14 Flip and Vivobook 16 have been launched in India. The new Vivobook laptops come with a metal build and offer military-grade durability. The new laptops run on Qualcomm Snapdragon X, Intel Core, Intel Core Ultra and AMD Ryzen 7 7000 series processors. Asus has also launched a new Wireless Silent Mouse MW103 alongside the new laptops.
title: Asus Vivobook S14, Vivobook S16, Vivobook 14 Flip, Vivobook S14 Flip and Vivobook 16 Launched in India

description: Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) rolled out its highly anticipated 4.6 Update on Wednesday. It brings a new supernatural-themed mode, the return of the popular Ocean Odyssey experience, and a new India-first character called Kiaraa. Krafton India has introduced collaborations with One Punch Man, Lincoln Motor Cruize, and B.DUCK, alongside new festive content planned around Diwali. Among the headline additions is a new Midnight Hunters mode, which allows eliminated players to return to the battlefield as Vampires.
title: BGMI 4.6 Update Rolls Out With Vampire Mode, Kiaraa, and One Punch Man Collaboration

description: Google is adding several new learning features to Gemini Notebook, including an audio recorder for lectures and thoughts and voice conversations on mobile. The service is also getting interactive learning overviews, more quiz formats and expanded Short Video Overviews. Voice chat will support nearly 100 languages, while the video feature will work in more than 80 languages. Google is offering college students free AI plan access for a year, with Google AI Pro available in the US and Google AI Plus offered across more than 140 markets.
title: Google Gemini Notebook Gets Voice Chat, Lecture Recording and New Study Tools

description: The Oppo F35 series is all set to be launched in India soon, comprising two models — Oppo F35 5G and F35 Pro 5G. While the company remains tight-lipped on what its upcoming F-series handsets could offer, Gadgets 360 has obtained an image of what appears to be the retail box of the higher-end model in the lineup. The image confirms the handset’s moniker as the Oppo F35 Pro 5G, while also suggesting its availability in two colour options.
title: [Exclusive] Oppo F35 Pro 5G Retail Box Surfaces Ahead of India Launch, Revealing Design and Colourways

description: Samsung could be preparing a new cloud backup option for its Gallery app as its integration with Microsoft OneDrive approaches its September 30 end date. A new version of Samsung's Gallery Cloud Sync service has reportedly appeared on the Galaxy Store. The description indicates that photos and videos can be backed up to Google Cloud. Samsung has not yet officially announced the new integration.
title: Samsung Gallery May Get Google Cloud Backup After OneDrive Sync Ends

description: Crypto markets saw about $571 million (roughly Rs. 5,479 crore) in long-position liquidations over 24 hours after the US Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act. Bitcoin and Ether accounted for roughly $190 million each, while XRP and Solana saw smaller losses. The Senate’s September 15 cloture vote on H.R. 3633 ended 49-50, falling short of the 60 votes required to advance the legislation.
title: Clarity Act Failure Leads to Liquidations of Crypto Longs Worth $570 Million

description: Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm and Redmi Buds 8s will be launched in China this month, the company has confirmed. While the Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm will be offered in blue, gray, green, purple, and silver colour options, the Redmi Buds 8s will ship in black, green, and white colourways. The Redmi Buds 8s are shown to feature a pebble-style charging case, with a horizontal LED indicator placed on the front. It will also sport a half-in-ear design, shipping without silicone tips. The Redmi branding appears inside the charging case.
title: Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm, Redmi Buds 8s Confirmed to Launch This Month; Design, Specifications Teased

description: Bitcoin has fallen below $76,000 as the failed CLARITY Act vote adds to pressure from rising Treasury yields and expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike. Market sentiment has also cooled, while mixed ETF flows and subdued whale accumulation point to softer demand. Traders are now watching the Fed’s policy decision and developments around US crypto legislation.
title: Bitcoin Drops Below $76,000 as CLARITY Act Vote Failure Adds to Pressure

description: Amazon is bringing its AI-powered Alexa+ voice assistant to India, the company announced at an event held in New Delhi on Wednesday. The move marks the expansion of the upgraded version of Alexa beyond the markets where it was initially introduced. Amazon says the AI assistant is designed to make conversations more natural while understanding context. Alexa+ can also control compatible smart home devices, perform tasks on the web, and use information across Amazon services to personalise responses.
title: Amazon Alexa+ Arrives in India for Free for Everyone With Smarter Conversations, Agentic Features, and More

description: Samsung Galaxy A18 4G has debuted in France with a 6.7-inch Super AMOLED screen and an Exynos 1610 chipset. The smartphone comes with 4GB of RAM and 128GB of storage, expandable through a microSD card. It features a 50-megapixel primary camera alongside ultrawide and macro sensors, plus a 13-megapixel selfie camera. The handset packs a 5,000mAh battery with 25W charging and carries an IP64 rating. Samsung has also confirmed long-term software and security support for the device.
title: Samsung Galaxy A18 4G Launched With 50-Megapixel Main Camera, Exynos 1610 SoC: Price, Specifications

description: Xiaomi 18 Pro has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number SM8975. The listing suggests that the flagship phone will be equipped with a QTI SM8975 chipset, which is the unreleased Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro SoC from Qualcomm. The chipset is expected to be built on a 2nm process, competing with the recently unveiled MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chip. The Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset on the Xiaomi 18 Pro will reportedly feature three efficiency cores clocked at 3.74GHz, three performance cores clocked at 4.03GHz, and two prime cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 5.01GHz.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Spotted on Geekbench With Unreleased Snapdragon 8 Elite Series Chipset

description: The Itel Muzik 450L was launched in India as the latest feature phone. It has a 2-in-1 high-output speaker and a 2,500mAh battery. It comes with a 2.4-inch QVGA display. The phone measures 13.4mm in thickness. It features the King Talker voice assistant. Itel Muzik 450L is priced at Rs. 1,659. Itel Muzik 450L has a VGA rear camera. It also has a built-in torch.
title: Itel Muzik 450L Feature Phone Launched in India With 2-in-1 Speaker: Price, Specifications

description: Microsoft on Tuesday announced a new Surface event for next month. While the Redmond-based tech giant has yet to reveal the specifics, it is expected to showcase how local AI could shape the next generation of Windows PCs. The event will bring together senior executives from Microsoft and Nvidia, with the companies expected to discuss new developments across Surface, Windows and the broader PC ecosystem. Details about the Surface Laptop Ultra and Surface RTX Spark Dev Box could also be revealed.
title: Microsoft Announces Windows and Surface Event for October to Showcase Local AI, Next Generation of AI PCs

description: Apple is said to be facing scrutiny in India over its warranty terms for software after complaints that the iOS 18 update caused display and microphone issues on some iPhone models. According to a report, India's consumer protection regulator is investigating whether consumers were unfairly asked to pay for repairs in cases where the problems were allegedly related to the software update. Apple's standard limited warranty covers hardware, while its software licence terms state that the software is provided without warranty.
title: Apple’s iOS 18 Warranty Terms Under Consumer Regulator’s Scrutiny in India: Report

description: Vivo Watch 6 will launch on September 21. Ahead of its official launch, the upcoming smartwatch is confirmed to feature a titanium alloy construction and sapphire crystal glass. It will ship with Vivo's BlueOS 4 skin. It is now available for pre-orders through the Vivo China website, JD.com, and Tmall. The Vivo Watch 6 will come with several health and fitness tracking features.
title: Vivo Watch 6 Design Revealed Ahead of September 21 Launch; Confirmed to Come With Titanium Body and BlueOS 4

description: The iQOO Pad Ultra is expected to be launched in China later this month alongside the iQOO 16. In the weeks leading up to its launch, the Vivo sub-brand has been revealing details about its next-generation flagship tablet. Now, it has surfaced on a benchmarking site, which offers an early look at its hardware and performance metrics. The listing suggests that the iQOO Pad Ultra could feature 16GB of RAM and run on Android 17.
title: iQOO Pad Ultra Geekbench Listing Reveals Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 Performance Figures

description: Oppo K14 Lite launched in India with a 7,000mAh battery. It runs on the Unisoc T7250 octa-core processor, paired with 4GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 64GB of UFS 2.2 storage. It has a 6.75-inch display and a 13-megapixel rear camera with autofocus. For selfies and video calls, it has a 5-megapixel front-facing camera.
title: Oppo K14 Lite Launched in India With 6.75-Inch Display, 7,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale 2026 will begin on October 9 in India, the e-commerce giant has announced. Moreover, a dedicated microsite for the sale event is now live in the country, teasing the bank discounts, special deals, and offers that will be available to customers when the sale begins. Additionally, the company has confirmed that the Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale 2026 will offer early access to Flipkart Plus, Flipkart Black, and Flipkart Credit Card members. The upcoming Flipkart sale event is expected to offer various electronics at relatively low prices from reputable global brands.
title: Flipkart Big Billion Days 2026 Dates Are Out: Bank Discounts and Deals Teased

description: Meta One has been launched by the US-based tech giant to offer a single subscription to Instagram Plus, WhatsApp Plus, and Facebook Plus users. The Meta One Core plan allows users to restyle Instagram stories, use voice effects, and other creative tools, while also offering higher usage limits to generate images and videos using Meta AI on Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp. With the Meta One Premium plan, users get additional usage limits for Meta AI tools and features.
title: Meta One Subscription Launched in India as a Single Plan for WhatsApp Plus, Instagram Plus and Facebook Plus With Higher AI Limits

description: Xiaomi has teased the launch of its Xiaomi 18 Pro series in China, revealing a new Versatile Back Screen feature for the secondary rear display. The screen can run small apps created for tasks such as cooking, hydration, productivity and language learning. The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max has also appeared on Geekbench with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset and Android 17. Earlier leaks have pointed to high-resolution cameras, a 7,000mAh battery and 100W wired charging for the Xiaomi 18 Pro.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Series Launch Officially Teased With New Rear Screen Feature

description: Reliance Jio and Canva have announced that they have entered into a strategic partnership in India. As part of the new partnership, Jio users will get 12 months of free Canva Pro and Canva Pro Lite subscriptions with Rs. 399 and Rs. 349 prepaid plans, respectively. Apart from these two plans, Reliance Jio has announced that all prepaid plans offering 2GB per day of high-speed data, priced above Rs. 349, will also get access to Canva Pro Lite at no extra cost. To claim the free Canva Pro and Canva Pro Lite subscriptions with the Rs. 399 and Rs. 349 prepaid plans, Jio users can visit the MyJio app on their smartphone.
title: Jio Users Get Free Canva Pro, Canva Pro Lite Subscriptions Worth Up to Rs. 4,000: Benefits, Offers
